arStrings.szText:
Dealing direct damage grants {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage for each enemy hit within {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 2" * Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c}.

At Maximum you gain:

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Critical Strikes have up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to deal double damage, Heal for {c_random}[Affix_Value_2]{/c} Life, and refresh the duration of the bonus.
